description: Get a presigned upload for your own audio file. Returns an upload_url (PUT the raw file bytes there, e.g. `curl -X PUT -H "Content-Type: <content_type>" --data-binary @song.wav "<upload_url>"`) and an audio_key to pass to doseedo_separate_stems / doseedo_transcribe / doseedo_cover_song / doseedo_audio_to_session, or to doseedo_add_audio_to_session. Formats: WAV, AIFF, FLAC, MP3, M4A/AAC, Ogg/Opus, WebM — all accepted for processing on every plan. Storing audio IN A SESSION (doseedo_add_audio_to_session) keeps WAV/AIFF/FLAC lossless only on Pro+; below Pro+ lossless is not kept there, so send Opus (audio/ogg). Samples/regions for a session that are on this machine need NO upload: use load_quick_sampler_sample sample_path / attach_audio local_path / set_track_clips audio_ref.local_path and run place_local_files after the download.

content_type.description: MIME type; inferred from the extension when omitted (wav, aif/aiff, flac, mp3, m4a/aac, ogg/opus, webm). Required for any other extension.

name: doseedo_get_upload_url
